completionCriteria.u3-check-35: Recorded through the existing 3.5 lesson-check rules: a checked lesson answer plus a short explanation or an on-paper indication.
completionCriteria.u3-transfer-complete: Derived only when all four hold: the angle setup is correct (opposite BC, adjacent AB, hypotenuse AC, tangent relationship), the current angle value matches its latest correct checked attempt with degrees and tenth rounding, the current length relationship (sine) and value match the latest correct checked attempt with metres and tenth rounding, and the triangle reasoning field holds a nonempty explanation.

stateCompatibility.migration: Saved state mentioning an inactive route is remapped to u3-overview only. Attempts, drafts, provenance, support flags, history, selected evidence, recovery data and every other field are preserved without reset.

retentionPolicy.note: Limits are unchanged from the imported candidate. Save failures stay visible; no silent truncation was added.
